citations.context: Interesting. But he removes the spirit, and you know what the text says? That he put a new spirit in. I'll just read it for you. It's plain as day. This is 1 Samuel 16 14. Now the spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit, ah, Brandon, see, God's spirit is gone, evil spirit. Keep reading. And an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him. I don't know how else to understand this verse, except God has multiple spirits, good ones that apparently want genocide, and then evil ones that he sends when someone doesn't commit genocide fully to torment the person for being disobedient, even though they were acting in the spirit of God that had been placed upon them.
citations.creator: mindshift
citations.title: God’s Favorite Weapon Is Confusion

text.KJV: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
